label: Counting convention
text: The principal bound of T72 counts carry events along the chain of constant-G segments. It bounds carries, not elapsed steps.

label: Static certification: prime g
text: Static certification (S3–S5) is proved for prime g. The six cycles g = 15, 39, 51, 57, 68, 87 fail S5, and the composite and even case is recorded as open (O12.2).

label: Bounds versus observation
text: The entry bounds are certified, not near-sharp. Observed entry indices sit far below them, and an exact transient time is recorded as open (O12.1).

label: Scope of the grammar
text: Every result is a statement about the chosen collective grammar C. Registered corrections are recorded as mathematical scope statements; open problems are listed in Appendix F.
